name: Two Maids of the Secret Manor
source:
Congratulations! You’ve inherited a grand mansion—but it comes with a secret: two young maids already reside there. They attend the same school as you, and you must keep both your ownership and their roles hidden.

As you settle into your new life, the girls compete for your attention while you begin to uncover the mansion’s dark past. Will you discover the truth behind it all?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.sadmaidgirl]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
恭喜！你继承了一座宏伟的宅邸——但它也附带着一个秘密：已有两名年轻的女仆居住其中。她们与你就读于同一所学校，而你必须将自己宅邸主人的身份以及她们的职责统统隐瞒起来。

随着你逐渐适应新生活，两位少女纷纷争相吸引你的注意，而你也开始揭开这座宅邸阴暗的过往。你能否查明这一切背后的真相？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.sadmaidgirl]Google Play[/url]]
